input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual, indirect damages are mutually excluded, and § 21.3 contains the full preferred set of Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) plus confirmation that Customer's payment obligation is not "damages". However, the cap basis is illusory: "Fees" is defined (§ 1.5/1.6) as the Implementation Fee only — a one-time USD 12,000 charge under the first Order Form — so the cap is effectively a fixed USD 12,000 rather than twelve months' fees, and it excludes all later Order Forms. That is far below the fallback of 12 months' fees and sits in walk-away territory (Vendor cap below 6 months' fees). Redline restores the preferred basis: greater of all amounts paid or payable in the prior twelve months and USD 1,000,000, leaving carve-outs intact.

proposal.summary: Fix illusory cap basis: greater of all fees paid or payable in prior 12 months and USD 1,000,000
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap is currently measured by "Fees", defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so it is effectively a fixed USD 12,000 cap. We have aligned it to our position: the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification and confidentiality/data-protection breaches remaining outside the cap as Excluded Claims.

ops.oldText: the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
